core_message: Built in a crash project as a psychological weapon, the Massive Ordnance Air Blast remains the largest conventional bomb ever used in combat.
title: How the US built the largest conventional bomb in history
description:
Discover the strange history of the GBU-43/B Massive Ordnance Air Blast, better known as the MOAB or Mother of All Bombs. Developed in a rushed crash project by the United States Air Force, this twenty-one-thousand-pound weapon was designed not just for destruction, but for psychological impact.

Learn how it links back to Vietnam War munitions, why it requires a cargo plane instead of a bomber, and how it was finally deployed in 2017.

Key points:
- The origin of the nickname
- The crash development process in 2003
- How it differs from a traditional nuclear weapon or heavy bomber raid

Based on the Wikipedia article "GBU-43/B MOAB" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GBU-43/B_MOAB), licensed CC BY-SA 4.0.
